svg.title: Meet the cast, in light and dark
svg.desc: A small Shiny-style app with four steps. Each step changes one mascot in the same corner, and its status text sits beside it. Tessa waits, then looks happy when the settings are saved. Sela thinks while the analysis runs. The app then switches to dark mode and the mascot follows. Knurl looks worried about a file, and Neer celebrates when the report is ready. Each change is a short wiggle and a new face.
